name: @ibkit/node
description: Interactive Brokers TWS API, Web API, FIX and ibkit control for Node.js and Bun, on the ibkit Rust core

scripts.build:ts: bun build ts/index.ts ts/gateway.ts --target node --format esm --splitting --outdir dist --external ./ibkit.node && tsc -p tsconfig.json --emitDeclarationOnly
